params.prompt: The character in <Picture 1> stands in place in a relaxed idle pose, seen in strict side view (profile), facing left, with a locked static camera. The blade feet stay planted on the ground and do not slide; the knees and backward-bending hocks flex only slightly with the weight shift. The character does not walk or turn. The full body from the top of the hood to the feet is always in frame and the feet are always visible.
